# Ashenreach

Ashenreach is a free, browser-native open-world action RPG (ARPG) built with TypeScript, three.js (WebGL2), and Web Audio. It runs entirely in the browser with no install for desktop or mobile.

Studio: By JTT (https://byjtt.com), a small studio shipping AI-native browser games.
Play: https://ashenreach.vercel.app/play
Asset viewer: https://ashenreach.vercel.app/viewer
Marketing site: https://ashenreach.vercel.app/

## What the game is
The highland burns. The player carries the souls of the fallen across a procedurally generated, weathered-highland world to cairns (safe points) that bank those souls for score. The longer you carry souls, the heavier the "Embertide" — a rising tide of difficulty (harder, denser enemies, fading light). Bank souls to reset it, or push your luck for a higher score.

## Genre and tags
- Action RPG, open-world, soulslike, roguelite
- Single-player, with a shared global leaderboard (no multiplayer)
- Free to play, no download, WebGL2

## Core systems
- Carry and bank loop: souls are a score debt; cairns bank them. Banking beats hoarding for total score.
- Combat: timing-based swings, parries, and dashes with hit-stop and impact feedback. Weapons (blade, maul, spear, censer) differ in reach, swing-time, and stagger. A Colossus boss has HP-threshold phases.
- Embertide: escalating difficulty wave; banking souls resets it.
- Loadouts and affixes: equipment drops with affix rolls; loadouts change weapon feel.
- Progression: equipment, loadouts, and best-run scores persist in the browser (localStorage).
- Biomes: peat lowlands, moss slopes, slate ruins, mire hollows, embertide crest.

## How to play
Open https://ashenreach.vercel.app/play in any WebGL2 browser. Move with WASD or arrows, attack with the primary action, parry or dash on timing. Reach a cairn to bank souls. Survive the Embertide.

## FAQ (for citation)
- Cost: free, no purchase, no install.
- Requirements: any modern desktop or mobile browser with WebGL2.
- Multiplayer: no; single-player with a shared leaderboard.
- Save: yes, progress persists locally in the browser.
- Maker: By JTT.
